scenarios.title: BIG CHIEF — Earth Shatter
scenarios.description: A golden-aura sword strike unleashes a shockwave across a rocky battlefield.

prompt.original: BIG CHIEF is @[Image 1]. He grips his machete hard, swinging it down and, crashes it into the ground in a huge dust explosion, then stands up grinning in the crater. Anime style, freeze-frame on his face.
prompt.improved:
BIG CHIEF is @Image 1
0:00–0:03
Visual: On a rocky cliff battlefield, BIG CHIEF stands grinning, a golden aura igniting around his massive frame, the sun tattoo on his shoulder glowing. He grips his glowing sword and leaps high into the air, boulders already trembling on the ground below him.
Camera: Slow push-in on his grin, then a fast tilt up as he launches skyward.
Mood: Confident, power building.
Style: High-contrast anime shading, warm gold aura against cool grey stone, dramatic lens flare as the aura ignites.
0:03–0:06
Visual: He plummets toward the ground with his sword raised overhead, the cliff face rushing past, boulders shaking loose beneath him.
Camera: Dynamic low-angle shot looking up at him, tracking his descent with a slight handheld shake.
Mood: Intense, gathering momentum.
Style: Bold anime linework, speed streaks, golden glow trailing off the blade.
0:06–0:08
Visual: He lands with tremendous force. A violent shockwave of dust and rock fragments erupts outward in a full ring around him, with bold shonen-style impact lines radiating from the point of contact.
Camera: Static shot with a hard camera shake on impact.
Mood: Explosive release.
Style: Flash-white impact frame, thick ink impact lines, heavy dust and rock particle effects.
0:08–0:10
Visual: The dust cloud swells and briefly obscures him entirely, with rock fragments arcing through the air.
Camera: Slow-motion wide shot, held static.
Mood: Chaotic, suspenseful.
Style: Muted earth-tone palette, soft motion blur on flying debris, dense particle effects.
0:10–0:12
Visual: The dust clears from the center outward, revealing him standing in a small crater, sword still raised, grinning through the settling debris.
Camera: Slow push-in through the thinning haze.
Mood: Triumphant reveal.
Style: Warm god-ray backlighting piercing cool grey dust, golden aura flickering back to life.
0:12–0:14
Visual: He surges forward through the drifting dust, cleaving a nearby boulder clean in half as he advances, the two halves splitting apart behind him.
Camera: Fast tracking shot alongside him, quick cut to a low angle on the slash.
Mood: Relentless, unstoppable.
Style: Fast cuts, high-contrast anime shading, bright slash streak along the blade, dust trailing in his wake.
0:14–0:15
Visual: Tight close-up on his triumphant grin, sunlight cutting through the haze around him. Freeze-frame to end.
Camera: Static close-up.
Mood: Triumphant, unstoppable.
Style: High-contrast freeze-frame, dramatic lens flare, warm highlight glow on his face.
changes: Divides the action into clear timed beats.
Adds camera direction, mood, and visual style for each beat.
Spells out the build-up, impact, and ending.

scenarios.title: BIG CHIEF — Flaming Leap
scenarios.description: A flaming machete, a fast charge, and an explosive finish across the savanna.

prompt.original: BIG CHIEF is @[Image 1]. He grins on a cliff edge, then leaps up heroically into the sky with a trail of flames following him as he lifts his machete. He hangs at the top of his jump, silhouetted against the sun. Anime style, freeze-frame on his falling silhouette.
prompt.improved:
BIG CHIEF is @Image 1
0:00–0:03
Visual: Wide shot over a green savanna dotted with palm trees. BIG CHIEF, grinning, grips his machete in one hand as flame ignites and rolls along the blade's edge with a soft "whoomph."
Camera: Static wide shot, slight low angle.
Mood: Rising energy, calm before the charge.
Style: Saturated green landscape against golden flame glow.
0:03–0:07
Visual: He rockets forward horizontally at full speed, flying low over the terrain, fire trailing off the machete's edge like a comet tail, grin stretched wide, wind whipping his cap and cloak backward, the wrapped weapon on his back rattling with the motion.
Camera: Fast lateral tracking shot matching his velocity.
Mood: Reckless momentum, joyful aggression.
Style: Motion-streaked fire trail, dynamic diagonal composition.
0:07–0:11
Visual: Dramatic low-angle cut as he rears the flaming machete back mid-swing, fire elongating into a wide fiery arc off the blade, muscles straining, teeth gritted into a fierce grin.
Camera: Slow-motion, low dramatic angle.
Mood: Explosive power building to release.
Style: Deep red-orange lighting, heavy shadow contrast.
0:11–0:14
Visual: The blade connects off-frame — a massive fireball blooms outward in blinding yellow-orange light, his silhouette barely visible at the center of the blast.
Camera: Static wide shot, flash-lit.
Mood: Cataclysmic release.
Style: Full-frame fire and light, near-abstract color bloom.
0:14–0:15
Visual: Final beat holds on a dark red-lit aftermath frame, embers drifting past his steady silhouette, machete lowered at his side, standing amid the dying flame.
Camera: Static, held frame.
Mood: Quiet aftermath of destruction.
Style: Dark ambient red lighting, ember particle effects drifting in the frame.
